images.name: are-you-all-alive
images.alt: The Rio Grande team after the stage, in a mountain town: five riders in red Rio Grande kit and a teammate in a red shirt pose with an older couple in yellow and pink shirts beside a white race bike; one rider's head is a cartoon Gravel God.
images.note: Only the pasted-on head changes; the body is a real photo.

images.name: early-pain
images.alt: Race photo of a small group on a desert highway, mountains behind: a rider in red-and-white Rio Grande kit, his head a focused cartoon Gravel God in profile, rides between a Landis Cyclery rider and riders in blue.
images.note: Only the pasted-on head changes; the body is a real photo.

images.name: fikk-den-gjort
images.alt: A rider in Rio Grande kit, his face a grinning cartoon Gravel God, rolls up the road from the Tour of the Gila 2024 finish arch and race clock, spectators at the orange barriers and pine-covered hills behind.
images.note: Only the pasted-on head changes; the body is a real photo.
